spec.name: tsz_V03_change_6m
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose V03 rate has risen most over six months relative to its own long-run history (expanding z-score) will have lower next-month returns, because deteriorating flow rates signal weakening conditions not yet priced in.
spec.falsified_if: Cross-sectional rank correlation between this feature and next-month return is non-negative on average, or top-minus-bottom quintile spread is positive.

spec.name: Composition-adjusted hours-to-wage spread
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose average hours are high relative to their average hourly pay (cross-sectional z-score spread) have a favorable composition of labor input versus cost, so they earn higher returns next month than groups with low hours relative to pay.
spec.falsified_if: Cross-sectional rank correlation between the feature and next-month group returns is zero or negative in development statistics, or top-minus-bottom quintile return spread is not positive.

spec.name: T_regime_conditioned_V02_V03_spread
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose V02 rate exceeds V03 rate (cross-sectionally standardized) earn higher next-month relative returns, and this effect is stronger when T is in its high regime, since the common index conditions how flow imbalances are priced.
spec.falsified_if: Under the high T regime, the cross-sectional rank correlation between the spread and next-month returns is zero or negative, or is not larger than in the low regime.

spec.name: V06_persist_rising_stock
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose V06 stock rate has risen in a larger share of months (persistent upward drift) will have lower next-month returns, because persistent deterioration in the stock signals slow-moving weakness that is underreacted to.
spec.falsified_if: Mean cross-sectional rank correlation with next-month return is non-negative, or HAC t-statistic is above -1 in absolute favor of a positive sign.

spec.name: Separation-minus-hiring composition spread
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose flow rate V02 is high relative to V03 (cross-sectional z-score spread of 6-month averages) have a labor-flow composition that predicts higher returns next month than groups with low V02 relative to V03.
spec.falsified_if: Mean cross-sectional rank IC is zero or negative in development statistics, or HAC t-stat is below 1.

spec.name: V04_V06_interaction_persistence
spec.hypothesis: Groups with a high V04 flow rate multiplied by a high V06 stock rate (both cross-sectionally ranked) earn lower next-month relative returns, because stacked flow and stock pressure signals mean-reversion in group performance.
spec.falsified_if: Cross-sectional rank correlation between the feature and next-month returns is zero or positive, with HAC t-statistic above -1.

spec.name: V05_yoy_wage_growth_low_T
spec.hypothesis: Groups with higher year-over-year change in V05 (dollars per hour) will have higher next-month returns in low-T regimes, because accelerating compensation signals stronger conditions not yet fully priced in. The effect should vanish in high T.
spec.falsified_if: Mean IC in the low-T regime is non-positive, or is not above the high-T IC, or the HAC t-statistic is below 1.

spec.name: Stock-rate composition against flow V04 spread
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose stock rate V06 (12-month average) is high relative to flow rate V04 have a more persistent, stable composition and earn higher returns next month than groups with low V06 relative to V04.
spec.falsified_if: Mean cross-sectional rank IC is zero or negative in development statistics, or HAC t-stat is below 1.

spec.name: V01_V05_hours_wage_interaction_T
spec.hypothesis: Groups with high V01 hours combined with rising V05 dollars-per-hour (both cross-sectionally ranked) earn higher next-month relative returns, since tight utilization plus price pressure signals strength. Effect is expected to be positive across T regimes.
spec.falsified_if: Cross-sectional rank correlation between the feature and next-month returns is zero or negative, or HAC t-statistic is below 1.

spec.name: V02_V04_spread_lagged_persist
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose V02 rate is high relative to V04 in cross-sectional standardized terms, after smoothing over 6 months, will have lower next-month returns, because a persistently elevated V02 versus V04 signals weakening conditions that are slowly priced in.
spec.falsified_if: Mean cross-sectional rank IC is non-negative, or HAC t-statistic is above -1, in the development sample.

spec.name: Hours-to-pay spread with 12-month trend change
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose average hours (V01) have risen relative to hourly pay (V05) over the past year, in cross-sectional terms, are gaining labor input versus cost and earn higher returns next month than groups where hours fell relative to pay.
spec.falsified_if: Mean cross-sectional rank IC is zero or negative in development statistics, or HAC t-stat is below 1.

spec.name: V04_V02_flow_spread_tsz_low_T
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose V04 rate is unusually high versus their own history, relative to V02 (cross-sectionally standardized spread of time-series z-scores), earn lower next-month relative returns, especially when T is in its low regime, since stretched flows mean-revert.
spec.falsified_if: Mean cross-sectional rank correlation with next-month returns is zero or positive, or HAC t-statistic is above -1, particularly in the low T regime.

spec.name: V01_hours_accel_smoothed
spec.hypothesis: Groups with accelerating average hours V01 (change over 3 months minus prior 3-month change) will have higher next-month returns, because hours adjust before other flows and the acceleration is only slowly priced in.
spec.falsified_if: Mean cross-sectional rank IC is non-positive or HAC t-statistic is below 1 in the development sample.

spec.name: Hours level relative to own history, ranked
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose average hours V01 are unusually high versus their own expanding history (time-series z-score) are in a stronger labor-input phase and earn higher returns next month than groups with unusually low hours.
spec.falsified_if: Mean cross-sectional rank IC is zero or negative in development statistics, or HAC t-stat is below 1.

spec.name: V04_V02_tsz_spread_reversed_mavg
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose V04 rate is unusually low versus its own history relative to V02 (spread of expanding-window time-series z-scores, smoothed) earn higher next-month relative returns, since submission 4 showed positive IC opposite to the stated sign; the effect should hold across T regimes.
spec.falsified_if: Mean cross-sectional rank correlation with next-month returns is zero or negative, or HAC t-statistic is below 1, in the full sample.

spec.name: V05_yoy_wage_growth_low_T_smoothed
spec.hypothesis: Groups with higher 3-month smoothed year-over-year change in V05 will have higher next-month returns, with a stronger effect when T is low. Smoothing reduces noise while keeping the regime-conditional signal seen earlier.
spec.falsified_if: Mean IC is non-positive, HAC t-statistic is below 1, or low-T IC is not above high-T IC in development.

spec.name: Hours-to-pay spread conditioned on high T regime
spec.hypothesis: The hours-to-pay composition spread (3-month averages) predicts next-month group returns more strongly when common index T is in its high regime, since high-T IC was 0.06 versus 0.03 in low T; groups with high hours relative to pay outperform.
spec.falsified_if: In development statistics, mean rank IC is zero or negative, or HAC t-stat is below 1, or high-T IC does not exceed low-T IC.

spec.name: V02_V04_tsz_spread_mavg
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose V02 rate is unusually high versus own history relative to V04 (smoothed, expanding-window z-score spread) earn higher next-month relative returns, matching submission 4's positive IC; effect should hold across T regimes.
spec.falsified_if: Mean cross-sectional rank correlation with next-month returns is zero or negative, or HAC t-statistic is below 1, in the full sample.

spec.name: V02_tsz_expanding_lag1
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose V02 flow rate is unusually high relative to its own expanding history tend to have lower next-month returns than groups with unusually low V02, so the feature's cross-sectional relation to future returns is negative.
spec.falsified_if: Cross-sectional rank correlation between this feature and next-month group returns is non-negative or statistically indistinguishable from zero in development statistics.

spec.name: V03_share_of_V02_plus_V03_flow_composition
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose V03 flow rate is high relative to V02 flow rate, smoothed over 6 months, have higher next-month returns, because the composition of flows toward V03 signals stronger conditions in that group.
spec.falsified_if: Cross-sectional rank correlation between this feature and next-month group returns is zero or negative in development statistics, or top-minus-bottom group return spread is not positive.

spec.name: tightness_x_wage_momentum
spec.hypothesis: Groups where the flow rate V03 has recently fallen relative to its own history, interacted with rising wage level V05 momentum, earn higher next-month returns; the product of the two standardized signals should positively rank-correlate with future group returns.
spec.falsified_if: Cross-sectional rank correlation of this feature with next-month group returns is zero or negative on average, or its top-minus-bottom tercile spread is not positive.

spec.name: V05_yoy_persist6_highT
spec.hypothesis: Groups with a higher share of positive monthly changes in V05 over the window, applied only in high-T regimes, have higher next-month returns than groups with a lower share, so the cross-sectional rank correlation is positive.
spec.falsified_if: Mean cross-sectional rank correlation with next-month returns is zero or negative, or the HAC t-statistic is below 1.5 in development statistics.

spec.name: V04_V06_composition_spread_3m_change
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose V04 flow rate rose more than their V06 stock rate over the last 3 months (cross-sectionally standardized) have higher next-month returns, because flow-versus-stock composition shifts signal improving conditions ahead of the stock.
spec.falsified_if: Mean cross-sectional rank IC is zero or negative, or HAC t-statistic is below 1 in development statistics, or the top-minus-bottom group spread is not positive.

spec.name: hours_x_separation_regime_spread
spec.hypothesis: Groups with rising average hours V01 while the flow rate V02 is low relative to its own expanding history earn higher next-month returns; the interaction of hours momentum and negative V02 standardized level should rank-correlate positively with future returns.
spec.falsified_if: Mean cross-sectional rank IC is nonpositive, or HAC t-statistic is below 1.5, or the top-minus-bottom tercile spread is not positive.

spec.name: V03_accel_csrank
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose V03 flow rate is accelerating, measured by the change in its 3-month change, have lower next-month returns than groups with decelerating V03, so the cross-sectional rank correlation with future returns is negative.
spec.falsified_if: Mean cross-sectional rank correlation with next-month returns is zero or positive, or the absolute HAC t-statistic is below 1.5 in development statistics.

spec.name: V03_V04_composition_spread_6m_mavg
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose V03 flow rate, smoothed over 6 months, is high relative to V04 flow rate (cross-sectionally standardized) have higher next-month returns, because a composition tilt toward V03 signals improving conditions. Expect positive IC in both T regimes.
spec.falsified_if: Mean rank IC is zero or negative, HAC t-statistic is below 1, or high_T and low_T IC have opposite signs in development statistics.

spec.name: hours_momentum_in_high_T
spec.hypothesis: Within the high-T regime, groups whose average hours V01 have risen over the past 3 months relative to their own 60-month history earn higher next-month returns; outside high-T the signal is muted. Predicts positive rank IC concentrated in high-T.
spec.falsified_if: High-T mean rank IC is nonpositive, or is not larger than low-T IC, or the HAC t-statistic is below 1.5.

spec.name: V06_yoy_spread_V04
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose V06 stock rate has risen more over 12 months relative to their V04 flow rate, compared cross-sectionally, have lower next-month returns, so the cross-sectional rank correlation with future returns is negative.
spec.falsified_if: Mean cross-sectional rank correlation with next-month returns is zero or positive, or the absolute HAC t-statistic is below 1.5 in development statistics.

spec.name: V02_V03_flow_spread_3m_change
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose V02 flow rate rose more than their V03 flow rate over the last 3 months (standardized across groups) have higher next-month returns, because a faster-moving composition shift should carry more signal than the smoothed levels tried earlier.
spec.falsified_if: Mean rank IC is zero or negative, HAC t-statistic is below 1, or high_T and low_T IC have opposite signs in development statistics.

spec.name: hours_wage_spread_high_T
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose average hours V01 have risen faster than wage level V05 over 3 months, in cross-sectional standardized terms, earn higher next-month returns, and this effect is concentrated in high-T. Predicts positive rank IC.
spec.falsified_if: Mean rank IC is nonpositive, HAC t-statistic is below 1.5, or high-T IC is not larger than low-T IC.

spec.name: V01_lchg3_csrank
spec.hypothesis: Groups with larger 3-month log increases in average hours V01, ranked cross-sectionally, have higher next-month returns than groups with smaller increases, so the cross-sectional rank correlation is positive.
spec.falsified_if: Mean cross-sectional rank correlation with next-month returns is zero or negative, or the HAC t-statistic is below 1.5 in development statistics.

spec.name: V04_V06_composition_spread_6m_change
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose V04 flow rate rose more than their V06 stock rate over the last 6 months (standardized across groups) have higher next-month returns, extending the 3-month version that showed positive IC. Expect positive IC in both T regimes.
spec.falsified_if: Mean rank IC is zero or negative, HAC t-statistic is below 1, or high_T and low_T IC have opposite signs in development statistics.

spec.name: flow_V04_minus_V06_stock_spread
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose flow rate V04 has risen over 3 months relative to their own 60-month history, while the stock rate V06 is comparatively low cross-sectionally, earn lower next-month returns. The spread of V06 and V04 should rank-correlate positively with future returns.
spec.falsified_if: Mean rank IC is nonpositive, HAC t-statistic is below 1.5, or the top-minus-bottom tercile spread is not positive.

spec.name: V04_chg3_csrank_lowT
spec.hypothesis: Groups with larger 3-month increases in the V04 flow rate, ranked cross-sectionally and applied only in low-T regimes, have lower next-month returns than groups with smaller increases, so the rank correlation is negative.
spec.falsified_if: Mean cross-sectional rank correlation with next-month returns is zero or positive, or the absolute HAC t-statistic is below 1.5 in development statistics.

spec.name: V04_V06_spread_3m_and_6m_change_avg
spec.hypothesis: Groups whose V04 flow rate rose more than their V06 stock rate over 12 months (standardized across groups) have higher next-month returns, extending the positive 3- and 6-month versions. Expect positive IC in both T regimes.
spec.falsified_if: Mean rank IC is zero or negative, HAC t-statistic is below 1, or high_T and low_T IC have opposite signs in development statistics.

spec.name: V06_stock_minus_V04_flow_spread
spec.hypothesis: Groups with a high V06 stock rate relative to V04 flow rate, cross-sectionally standardized, earn higher next-month returns, since a persistent stock exceeding current flow suggests stability. Predicts positive rank IC.
spec.falsified_if: Mean rank IC is nonpositive, HAC t-statistic is below 1.5, or top-minus-bottom tercile spread is not positive.
